sentences.en: The director changed the camera angle to make the building look taller.
sentences.zh: 导演改变了镜头角度，使这栋楼看起来更高了。

sentences.en: In the movie, the close-up camera angle made me feel like I was there.
sentences.zh: 在这部电影里，特写镜头的角度让我感觉自己就在那里。

sentences.en: The photographer experimented with different camera angles to capture the best shot.
sentences.zh: 摄影师尝试了不同的镜头角度来拍摄最好的照片。
